translated_text: My dear Liginiae, November 14, 1940. Everything! I finally have, finally my Liebes, my everything! Remember your letter from Pezenas, dated May 9. And finally you have heard from me! I wrote almost every day to Villeneuve & you or yesterday I sent (It was the first day we could do that) Now all this with friends of friends, I had such a arrival in Pézenas I am so stupid Pézenas I am so happy my Bobelen you are finally Iment de chaprun a te ir saus ardent, san linge, sans rien que I asked you in my second telegram if you needed money but I didn't dare ask you because I absolutely didn't know if you did. Now, tell me right away if you want me to send you money to Agde you can only buy yourself some clothes. You mustn't leave any flannel trousers, you must have gray ones because unfortunately I only have one suit for you. You also need shoes. Buy them now because for the future my Liebling it's difficult to decide anything - We must know what we can do, what we will be allowed to do Can't we be asked to return to Paris with the other refugees? But Etienne, you and I will certainly be able to. And then they can, I believe, take care of our affairs. I would like to go to Pézenas, and I also believe that going to Paris will be much easier, that we can set up a laboratory either in Pézenas or Béziers. We would need to look into this more closely. I think the best thing would be for Mama to come with us. She can help me a lot, and I can't leave her alone in Paris. Anyway, Bobchen, now all of that is quite secondary, now that, God willing, we can, as I begin, my small and very modest life together, together, I don't even dare, it's too beautiful. It would be truly magnificent if you could come and get me, Liginiae, because of the car, because I wouldn't like to drive alone - that you will be allowed to!! - But money is going quite well: I received almost all the benefits we have. From Lucien, I haven't received anything since June, but that's not surprising. Now I expect something every day. So if you want to come to Liginiae, gladly return to Pézenas with you, only we need to know first... if they'll let us settle there. Finally, we'll certainly only be the ones you ask in Agde, the only ones who won't want to return to... But can't we... Everything is worth seeing for nothing - I would very much like to know about that lady who lived next to us at the grand hotel. Has Prohaska returned? And if Rudolfer is in Agde, I believe Pleterre, since his father is there, and some important figures, business. Especially my... A thug leterre. Give me news of everyone I know. Have you received anything? It doesn't matter. If not, you haven't... I'll make you my little map to locate Liginiae. Come either from Neuvic (7 km from Liginiae) or from Ussel (20 km) or from Bort (20 km) from Neue and... from Ussel You have a little train once a day. Neuvic departs 30 times in the morning. (3:45 PM) From Bort you arrive at 4 PM. From Tulle, it's from there the little train or the car. If you're coming to Mauriac, telegraph me. Ussel is 27 km away, I'll wait for you, or you can pick me up by car. 50 km to Neuvic, 30 km to Tulle, 20 km to Tulle. PS: If you arrive in Liginiae, let me know. I'm known at the Post Office and the town hall. Now I hope to have letters from you every day, my dearest – I'll write to you every day too. I adore you, Robilan / I adore you even more than before. It's true that I'll see you again soon.
